name: klayson
description: Klayson's plugin: give your agents your brand guide, extract any site's brand, and check designs against it.

plugins.name: klayson
plugins.description: Klayson is the brand and design source of truth for your agent: it reads your brand guide (logo, colors, typography, voice, layout, components and a page for each medium) before it builds anything, edits the guide with you, extracts the brand of any website, and checks what your agent made against the brand.
